scope: unmerged sixth ordered FreeCAD development default-importer patch; bounded closed polygon-mesh seams
base: FreeCAD d956ec561639cfa83f755504b1b3358ea799428e with five prior default-importer patches applied
nativeBuild: Headless macOS ARM64 FreeCADCmd built from exact source archive 29bdfe30632e084c0b6d015a1258f0ff75b8ed84fca660cec4e74fd4e2604bb9, AppleClang 21, Qt 6.12, OCCT 7.9.3; five prior patches applied
change: Construct periodic M and/or N seam cells for otherwise bounded unsmoothed planar polygon meshes; require at least three vertices in each closed direction, and retain all prior ownership, metadata, finite-coordinate and geometry validation.

validation.baseline: The previous open-grid importer refuses closed grids and fails the proposed regression; the candidate accepts the bounded closed profiles.
validation.generatedTest: Nine generated profiles: M-closed, N-closed and both-closed accepted; too-small periodic dimensions, nonplanar and degenerate seams, smoothing and extra flags explicitly refused. Each retains the following LINE. A second same-file test verifies a bad closed seam followed by a valid mesh and LINE, with no partial geometry.
validation.independentPeer: ezdxf 1.4.5, commit 84ae31976940f99e6d5f4d3b2e9131da02b574fe, independently expands the generated meshes into 3, 3 and 9 3DFACEs for M, N and both closure. Native FreeCAD face vertex sets and winding match. The doubly closed witness is a planar combinatorial control with overlapping cells, not a general closed surface.
validation.nested: Generated M-closed 3x2 controls in inches and millimetres match peer-expanded faces after two 90-degree nested INSERTs.
validation.combined: All ten assembled tests pass for DIMENSION basis, SOLID OCS, 3DFACE, classic polylines, POLYFACE and open/closed polygon meshes and recovery. Six ordered patches apply to the exact source; the built importer matches the assembled source.

limits: Six downstream FreeCAD default-importer patches remain unmerged; native checks use headless Import.readDXF into isolated new documents, not full GUI open/insert or Linux/Windows.
Closed directions with fewer than three vertices, smoothing, nonplanar cells, per-face styling, invisible edges, custom layers and unsupported metadata remain explicitly refused.
No physical producer sample, arbitrary nested transforms, binary DXF, allocation-fault injection, or producer/native semantic equivalence is established.
Scratch fixture files are not committed and no phase or format-support claim is promoted.
